gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads friendly and low-slung, a tall band of letters under short stalks. Noto Sans Cherokee settles the page while Tourney stretches its tubing-like capitals wide and loud above it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Neon tubing, stretched wide. Noto Sans Chorasmian is the real strength here: its curves stop short of closing, and the large lowercase keeps the loud Tourney heading company.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Brash yet tidy. Tourney is best at blunt, stretched-out display lines with no swell at the curves, while Noto Sans Coptic does its best work in the dense middle band of a paragraph, with open s and c shapes.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Tourney's wide-tracked letters look like neon tubing, every line cut to a single width. Noto Sans Cuneiform follows with puffed, bead-like lowercase and an e that stays open, so the heading's hard edge gets a softer neighbor.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Tourney stretches bulky, athletic letters wide, every stroke a single monoline width across the heading. Noto Sans Deseret is the foil, with open apertures.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Restrained, almost shy: that is Noto Sans Devanagari, with an open-curved g and capitals that melt into the lowercase. Noto Sans Devanagari quietly handles the reading, whereas Tourney is best at shouting in wide, lockstep curves and stems.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Tourney brings athletic, wide-tracked letters where curves and stems move in lockstep, almost like bent wire. And Noto Sans Duployan answers with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, giving the loud heading something friendly underneath.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Wire-bent letters, stretched wide and bold. And Noto Sans Elbasan is what holds the pair together, with large lowercase forms and open terminals that never pinch shut.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Tourney draws its bulky letters with a fixed-width stencil brush line, stretched out wide and sporty. Noto Sans Elymaic stays quiet below.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Loud, wide, tube-lit lettering. Noto Sans Ethiopic gives Tourney a sturdy, tall-lowercase partner with c terminals hanging far from the bowl, and a slightly larger size for the body would let that shape breathe.
